reason: Every notice already lands in my class WhatsApp groups, and I check those all the time on the metro anyway. Maybe I'd install it if the college pushed it, but within a couple of weeks I'd forget it was there and my phone storage is already full.
objection: Not another app on my phone. WhatsApp already does this for free, and I don't trust that the college will actually post things there on time instead of just dropping them in the group like they do now.
would_change_my_mind: If the college stopped posting notices in WhatsApp groups and UniDash became the only place to get exam dates and deadlines first.
